statement: The v7.3 dummy_hcd implementation explicitly has no isochronous endpoints and does not support isochronous URB execution, whereas both f_uac1 and f_uac2 use isochronous audio streaming endpoints. Therefore an unmodified dummy_hcd cannot provide functioning UAC playback/capture even when configfs can describe a composite gadget; bind failure or incomplete enumeration must be verified on a real host rather than guessed.

applicability.revision: Linux mainline v6.11, v6.12 or v7.3 as pinned; family revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Kernel structural incompatibility for source-only dummy_hcd + f_uac1/f_uac2; no local kernel, host bind attempt or audio stream measurement.
